author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
​@AmericanMuseumofNaturalHistoryhas tens of millions of insect and invertebrate specimens, and they've launched a massive initiative to digitize them all. But in the course of describing that fascinating project, division chair of invertebrate zoology Jessica Ware dropped some stunning factoids on Adam Savage -- like the fact that dragonflies, which date back more than 300 MILLION years, were the first winged insect. See for yourself.

Visit the American Museum of Natural History: https://www.amnh.org/
